corrections.what: 46 agreeing vision claims misread the tempo display as 140 (true value 160, verified by zoomed crops); the spoken '140' intro example likely anchored the misread
corrections.lesson: small-digit displays need digit-level certainty or OCR-grade zoom; confident-and-numerous is not the same as correct; corrector-verified claims override (shipped)

corrections.what: missed the 808/bounce build (~585-610s, 'I added another 808') and the hat rolls (~933s) — over-aggressive talk-only classification after the empty-ops fix
corrections.lesson: a step that names a concrete addition ('I added X', 'grab a hat, drag it out') is a build step even inside an explanation

corrections.what: single-track pitch-lane drums diverged from the screen's 4-channel rack; duplicate set_tempo re-emitted; notes beyond clip length
corrections.lesson: mirror the visible channel structure (one track per rack channel); never re-emit ops in the session summary; notes must fit the clip

corrections.what: FL wrench-tool micro-delay (systematic late nudge of selected notes) has no IR op; approximated with seeded humanize
corrections.lesson: IR v0.2 candidate: notes.nudge {clip_id, selector, offset_beats}

corrections.what: duplicated vision claims saturated L2 (0.958) and the L2-only rule crowned a near-empty build gold
corrections.lesson: dedupe (kind,value) claims; gold requires L2>=0.8 AND judge>=4 (both shipped)

corrections.what: samplers had no sounds — the replication was structurally right and SILENT (Emilio's listen test failed at hello)
corrections.lesson: IR v0.2 promoted early per s14.5: device.load_sound (asset->sampler binding) — audibility is part of correctness; rescore now flags silent bounces

corrections.what: CLAP text->one-shot ranking is noisy on transients (a water-drop perc outranked real claps for 'rnb clap')
corrections.lesson: use CLAP as a tiebreak over token+pack-context prefiltering, not as the oracle; resolver scores the full crate path, not just filenames

corrections.what: Emilio's grid corrections: kick channel plays NO steps (loaded but unused) and the 32nd hat roll was demoed, not kept — the corrector ALSO over-included demonstrated material
corrections.lesson: demo-vs-kept applies to the corrector too; the human ear is the final arbiter — exactly why Claude-corrected caps at silver until sign-off. 808/clap/hat placements confirmed unchanged.
